notes.title: Prepping for SxSW demo
notes.content:
Setting up a build for the SxSW demo playtest,

Lots of changes to test in this one.

notes.title: WIP Backpack
notes.content:
The player now has a backpack they drop with "T" (Crosspad UP) and pick up with "A"

With this backpack, players are able to pick up and scavenge for resources which they will later use to upgrade their gear and gain new weapons 

This is still a very early introduction therefore I won't mention to much, but I did want to say something at the very least.

notes.title: Massive changes all around!
notes.content:
This new patch includes optimizations
Updates to the environment art
Changes to the combat gameplay
Additions of enemies 
Removal of encounter walls
Balancing of damage and health
Updates to the AI Stunnable attack states
Addition of a few VFX components 
Updated character lighting

notes.title: Performance test additions
notes.content:
This updates brings in a large amount of new additions, which need to be tested for performance

New additions include
+ New Train Hub Level
+ Main City Map exploration and encounter gameplay loop
+ Additions of lighting elements in the level
+ Improvements to the combat system
+ and much more

notes.title: Environment Changes
notes.content: This update just includes some environment changes, bug fixes and slight adjustments to animations

notes.title: Small Balancing Patch
notes.content:
Updated player health to accommodate for the availability for stun locking.
Updated the direction marker to change color when lock on is active

Updated some of the beginning frames for a heavy attack

Allow heavy attacks to deal damage sequentially during the same attack

notes.title: Combo System Rework!
notes.content:
Just updated how the combo system works

Previously the combo system was based of an input combo window, if the player pressed the correct combo input in the allotted combo window the next combo would trigger

This is no longer the case, instead i took inspiration from the PS2 era God of War games and allow the next combo input to be buffered as long as the the current combo attack is still running, then i setup a window where i essentially lock an animation from changing then trigger the next combo as soon as that window is over.

Long story short, the combo input system has changed into what i hope is something better.

Also you can now inject your abilities in-between combos, they will no longer reset your combo.
